Google Test is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2014.

What it was for: [Science and visualisation](@/projects/science.md) (1) and [Security and OSINT](@/projects/security.md) (1).

Most recently: [algorithms](@/work/algorithms.md): Algorithms implementation; [peacemaker](@/work/peacemaker.md): Packet sniffing and processing engine.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Google Test: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Google Test to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
